name: comp-98

frames.best_why: The plus has finished spinning into a clean white X, showing the expanded state.

tagline: Spins a plus into a close cross on click, then unwinds it back.
summary: A small circular outlined icon button holding a plus. Each click rotates the glyph about 135 degrees with a slight overshoot, so the plus becomes an X and back again.
appearance: A thin-bordered dark circle sits on a near-black stage with a slender white plus centred inside. A single line of grey caption text runs beneath it.
behaviour: Clicking the circle rotates the plus into an X in about half a second, overshooting a touch before settling; clicking again unwinds it. The fill darkens slightly on hover and focus draws a ring.
demo_content: The caption "Quick actions: the plus spins into a close icon".
search_phrases: plus icon that turns into an x
icon button that rotates on click
use_when: A small square or panel expands from one button and the same control must also close it again.
avoid_when: It is icon only with no visible text, so the plus needs surrounding context to be understood.
customise: No props are exposed: the icon, the easing and the open/close aria labels are written into the file, so reuse means copying and editing it.
weight_why: One button and one rotated icon, with a single transition per click.

a11y.note: aria-expanded plus a swapping aria-label explain the state, but the overshoot spin has no reduced-motion fallback.

polish_why: Crisp circle and a playful overshoot spin; beneath that it is just an icon button.
title: Animated Plus Toggle
